ops.text: evidence 7 (f3749ee, run 36762027956): the Linux suite is down to ONE failing test on both test-linux and the linux-smoke Go step: internal/cli TestEnsureLocalEndpointsRegistersInstalledLinuxBrowsers expected both Default and "Profile 3" to register, but ensureLocalEndpoints registers one primary profile per browser by design (cookies.go:106-111, same as Darwin) — a test-expectation defect, fixed by expecting only Default. Everything else on Linux passed: no hangs, no build failures, internal/bridge (real headless Chrome via COOKIESYNC_SMOKE_CHROME) and internal/cookie (real session-bus Secret Service via COOKIESYNC_SMOKE_DBUS under dbus-run-session) green, scripts/linux-smoke.sh "all checks passed". lint/lint-linux on f3749ee had 4 mechanical findings (unused darwin-only helper, G101 on synthetic secrets, gofumpt, prealloc), fixed in 3a1f73a. macOS test, release-assets, vuln, vuln-linux, workflow, Socket all green.
